code.commit_subject: variants FINDINGS 7: v14 stack WINS unseen at both seeds (179/177 vs 172/170, Fisher ~0.016; s8 adds first unseen moves win) -- adopted as lab recipe

conclusion: SELECTED by val_policy_top1; benched in fwd-rescue-selected-bench.
variant_conclusion: Tuning helped a little - a perfect score on the puzzles with known answers, +13 solved overall - but nowhere near enough: the backward planner still wins by a wide margin. The scale claim survives its fairness test.
variant_description: A fairness check demanded by review: maybe the forward planner only lost because it was under-tuned. We gave it nine fresh training runs (3 seeds x 3 learning rates) and promoted the best by validation score alone - never by peeking at the test set.
